file.conflict: {path} changed on disk and here — pick one
session.resumed: Reconnected — the project is attached again
settings.fs.maxFileMb: Largest file kept in memory, MB
settings.fs.noScan: Folders search and language servers skip
settings.fs.watchDebounceMs: Pause before reading a change, ms
shell.missing: No one is drawing the panels
shell.missing.none: No plugins loaded at all — check the server log.
shell.missing.why: The layout is a plugin: the core keeps a registry of panels and a place for them, but nothing has claimed that place. Add a layout plugin to "plugins.enabled" in config/settings.json — ours is @mosetta/ide-plugin-layout.
